survey.title: A Systematic Literature Review on Large Language Models for Automated Program Repair

criteria: Core: automatically repairs bugs or security vulnerabilities in programs (automated program repair) using large language models or pretrained language models of code.
Fine-tuning, prompting, conversational and agent-based repair, repair-specific benchmarks and empirical evaluations of LLM-based repair all count.

Out of scope: repair without learned language models (search-, template- or constraint-based APR); code generation or completion that does not repair existing code; fault localization, test generation or code review alone.
